hero.title: Terms and Conditions
hero.description: Welcome to Velocita Indigo. These terms govern your use of our elite cycling marketplace and the services we provide. Please read them carefully to understand your rights and obligations.

sections.title: Introduction
body: Velocita Indigo (referred to as "we", "us", or "our") provides a digital platform for the curation, listing, and acquisition of elite cycling equipment. By accessing our platform, you agree to be bound by these terms.
Our service is designed for professional enthusiasts who value transparency, authenticity, and mechanical excellence. Any deviation from these core pillars may result in suspension of access.

quickTake.title: Quick Take
quickTake.text: By using this site, you agree to follow the rules of the elite cycling community.

checkItems.title: Account Registration
checkItems.description: You may be required to create an account to access certain features. When registering, you agree to provide accurate, complete, and current information and to update it as necessary.

checkItems.title: Account Security
checkItems.description: You are solely responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. Notify us immediately of any unauthorised use.

checkItems.title: Suspension & Termination
checkItems.description: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms, engage in fraudulent activity, or misuse our platform without prior notice.

sections.title: Listing Rules
sections.intro: All listings on Velocita Indigo must meet our quality and accuracy standards. Our editorial team reviews every listing to maintain marketplace integrity.

prohibited.title: Not Allowed
items: Providing inaccurate mileage or condition data.

best.title: Required
items: Include original proof of ownership documents.
Disclose all service records and accident history.
Provide high-resolution photos from multiple angles.

sections.title: Payments
body: Some services on our platform may require payment. All prices are shown in INR and are subject to applicable taxes. We use industry-standard payment gateways to process transactions securely.

By submitting payment information, you authorise us to charge the specified amount. Refunds are governed by our Refund Policy. Velocita Indigo does not store your card details directly on our servers.

sections.title: Liability
body: Velocita Indigo acts as an intermediary marketplace and does not own, inspect, or guarantee any vehicle listed on the platform. We are not liable for any damages arising from transactions between buyers and sellers.

To the maximum extent permitted by law, Velocita Indigo shall not be held responsible for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages — including loss of profits, data, or goodwill — arising from your use of our services.
